title: True Kinship: Maintaining Ties Despite Severance
summary: This Hadith teaches that true kinship is not about reciprocating kindness but maintaining relations even when others sever ties.
translation: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Umar, may Allah be pleased with them, he stated that the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, said: 'The one who reciprocates kindness for kindness is not truly maintaining kinship. Rather, the real maintainer of kinship is the one who, when ties are severed with them, still seeks to mend them.' It is clear that if someone treats you well and you treat them well in return, that is not true kinship; it is mere reciprocation. True kinship is when, despite neglect or severed relations by others, you continue to treat them well and maintain good relations. Hence, it is reported that the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, mentioned to people, 'Shall I not tell you of the best manners of this world and the hereafter?' The companions replied affirmatively. He then advised: 'Forgive those who wrong you, give to those who withhold from you, and maintain ties with those who sever them with you.'
